entry.subject: 北宋中原 浅薄河埠岸台（原创扩展；建筑细部待考）
entry.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Generate exactly ONE isolated production city-map building sprite for tianshu, Northern Song central plains Kaifeng/Luoyang around 1093. Reference images supply only realistic ancient materials and detail density; never copy reference camera mistakes or southern lush vegetation. Historical realistic grey clay tile, warm grey plaster over earth and rough bricks, matte weathered timber; restrained subtle ochre and red where structural. NOT toy, plastic, miniature diorama or ink wash. Orthographic yaw45 elevation30, ground axes EXACT slopes +0.5/-0.5 (2:1 dimetric), parallel opposite edges, upright columns, NO perspective. South entrance faces screen LOWER LEFT. Entire isolated footprint on one extremely thin flat ground-contact parallelogram with left, bottom/front and right corners clearly visible for grid calibration. Only a shallow masonry contact strip, NO thick plinth. Upper-left screen illumination, short contact shadow towards lower-right. TRUE transparent RGBA background, at least10% clear margins all sides. All roof ends and ground corners visible. No text, writing, signs, symbols, watermark, people, surrounding city, sky, trees outside footprint, modern objects, Qing ornament, imperial yellow roofs, thick bases or checkerboard. Subject: ONE extremely thin Northern Song central-plains river landing apron ONLY, narrow10m east-west by4m north-south flat grey stone strip with uneven ancient rectangular slabs, two short timber mooring posts and one loose rope contained inside. Optional2 very shallow waterside steps on lower-left side. NO river, water, boat, hut, buildings, plants, floating island or thick earth platform. Ground corner targets in1536x1024: left(100,400),front(1100,900),right(1500,700),back(500,200), up to uniform scale/translation. Axis ratio10/4 exactly, slopes+0.5/-0.5; final canvas is NOT required to be2:1 aspect ratio, only ground projection. Very low isolated attachment for later code composition. All background alpha zero.
entry.negative: 文字、水印、现代元素、人物、场景背景、厚底座、塑料感、清式重彩、黄琉璃宫顶、透视汇聚

references.role: 宋套件仅材质与写实细节参考；非本图几何或历史准确性背书

entry.created_time_basis: 源PNG文件mtime；非服务端披露调用时间

steps: one uniform LANCZOS resize with integer size rounding
pad RGBA; original alpha preserved; no thresholding, repaint, warp or flip

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工量可见薄底面三角点；后角遮挡推算，非测绘；残差不以几何变形修正

anchor_rounding_correction.reason: 按整数resize后的sx/sy转换，避免requested scale的亚像素偏移；未改图像或底面测点

entry.notes: 已逐张view_image原图与最终PNG自查。河埠仅薄石岸台、木桩和绳索，无船无水无背景；最低石边完整，原图低alpha残迹触边，补透明余量不裁实体。单视图；运行时拼接待实测；形制组合为原创扩展，细部待考。
